resolverConvention.conditionFormat: The authoringPredicate preserves raw input spelling; condition is the shared bounded path/op/value AST compiled through question-registry canonicalTarget and typed normalization. No separate runtime condition language is proposed.
resolverConvention.enabledWorkflowIdsMeaning: Available configured workflow definitions only. Enabling a definition does not instantiate a child task, dispatch, reservation, invoice or charge. An actual selected offering/fulfilment mode and a registered execution rule must request any linked child; parent/child identity, shared capacity and billing ownership prevent duplicate work or charges.
resolverConvention.rentalDriverPolicy: with_driver enables driver assignment and joint vehicle/driver reservation inside WF_RENTAL. It never enables WF_TRANSFER by itself. Standalone transfer work requires a separately selected and configured transfer activity.
resolverConvention.unknown: Missing answers remain unresolved; never silently convert them to false or invent a provider capability.
